content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free hosting service that allows you to publish web content directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means you can set up an online store without incurring monthly fees or transactional costs imposed by traditional platforms. Unlike Gumroad, which charges up to 10% per sale, GitHub Pages combined with NOWPayments allows you to maintain more of your earnings. This infrastructure empowers creators in underserved markets to monetize their digital products effectively and sustainably.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture operates through a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. This setup requires minimal investment and leverages free tools to ensure high scalability. When a customer purchases a product, the backend logic instantly handles the payment verification, while file delivery is managed through cloud storage solutions. This streamlined process not only minimizes costs but also enhances the user experience by providing instant access to purchased products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators who face restrictions from conventional payment platforms. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products in markets like Pakistan, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe, this system provides the autonomy and control you need. By utilizing GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can circumvent the barriers posed by traditional platforms, allowing you to engage directly with your audience and keep more of your hard-earned revenue.
Stop losing revenue to high platform fees — switch to a sovereign infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The main components of this architecture include GitHub Pages for the website, NOWPayments for payment processing, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, and either Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Each component plays a critical role: GitHub Pages hosts your site, NOWPayments processes payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and cloud storage provides reliable and instant file delivery. This interconnected setup not only reduces costs but also ensures that you own and control every aspect of your digital storefront.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your digital product store, start by setting up a GitHub account and create a repository for your website. Next, use GitHub Pages to host your site. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic to handle orders. Configure NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments securely. Finally, set up your file storage through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless product delivery. With The Sovereign Blueprint ($47), you can access comprehensive documentation and source code to simplify this process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Own your entire digital store without monthly subscriptions or hidden costs.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account and set up a new repository for your digital store. 2. Enable GitHub Pages to host your site for free. 3. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for processing orders. 4. Configure NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing and delivering your digital products. 6. Follow the documentation provided in The Sovereign Blueprint for detailed setup instructions.
